# EUlabel Documentation

> EUlabel is a GS1-conformant Digital Product Passport platform for EU regulatory compliance. This index links to markdown versions of every documentation page. For the full documentation in a single file, see: https://eulabel.eu/docs/llms-full.txt

- [EUlabel Documentation](https://eulabel.eu/docs/index.md)
